all_branches_sweep.procedure_of_record: measurement/carcasum_arb_challenge_prep/DESIGN.md §4.1, as extended by measurement/h2h_22016_prep/BAND_CLAIM.json. For EVERY ref in refs/heads and refs/remotes: read that ref's own governance/BAND_REGISTRY.csv AND every measurement/**/BAND_CLAIM*.json it carries; take the lowest integer clear of everything found anywhere across ALL refs, not just the checked-out branch's registry high-water mark.
all_branches_sweep.why_the_main_tree_check_is_insufficient: Bands 143000000000 and 144000000000 were each double-claimed on 2026-08-24 by concurrent prep sessions whose registry checks were scoped to the checked-out branch and therefore could not see an unmerged sibling freeze branch's own row. Both collisions were caught pre-launch at zero games and self-amended.
